programmes.d: Mysterious tape recordings accusing a company of illegally dumping toxic waste seem like a prank until Hunter and McCall find that someone is willing to kill to conceal the truth.
When Hunter confronts the police department to defend the actions of a Chinese-American policewoman critically wounded in the line of duty, the pair heads to Chinatown.
While investigating an armed robbery, Tony goes undercover and hires an escort to get some important information. He is shocked when his friend's daughter shows up as the escort.
Tony uncovers the shakedown of a community of illegal immigrants; David wants an earring to impress a girl.
Tony believes an officer posing as a corrupt cop to expose a crime ring may actually be the genuine article.
Vinnie joins his old neighborhood friends for a bachelor party but ends up finding one of his pals in trouble with a loan shark.
Vinnie goes underground as a small-town deputy to root out the corruption in a company town run by one man: the reclusive Old Man Volchek.
Vinnie enlists Frank's help when two of Stem's deputies are murdered.
Hunter and McCall try to solve a bank robbery and murder while coping with the double and triple-crossing schemes of a criminal who once saved Hunter's life.
When the husband of a policewoman is murdered, evidence of wife abuse makes Hunter and McCall suspect the woman's patrol partner who knew about the beatings.
A veteran police dispatcher is blackmailed into undermining Hunter's and McCall's investigation of a multimillion-dollar gold robbery when her son is kidnapped.
A top aide gets too close to an embezzlement and kidnapping case involving an ex-girlfriend.
A corrupt ex-officer whom Tony imprisoned seeks revenge upon his release.
Tony sets out to prove a mental patient isn't guilty of murder.
Vinnie bolts after watching Stem kill himself by electrocution, the same way Sonny Steelgrave killed himself. But suddenly Roger Lococco shows up.
McPike and Lococco wrap up their investigation of Volchek while Vinnie takes a job with an unscrupulous waste disposal company.
McPike and Lococco help Volchek come to grips with his family's legacy while Vinnie moves to stop the illegal dumping of hospital wastes.
